steps.title: Sample Preparation and Storage
steps.instruction: Randomize plasma samples on dry ice and store at -80 °C until extraction.

steps.title: Tissue Homogenization
steps.instruction: Prepare tissue samples for extraction using water and sonication.

substeps.instruction: Transfer samples (weight < 100 mg, if not cut) into eppendorf tubes.
Add 170 µL of water (LC-MS Chromasolv Fisher Scientific Catalog #15665350).
Cut samples into small pieces using small scissors.
Sonicate samples using a Vibracell VCX 130 ultrasonic processor with a 2 mm probe for 10 s, five times, at 40% amplitude.

steps.title: Protein Assay Aliquoting
steps.instruction: Reserve a portion of the homogenate for protein quantification.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 20 µL of homogenate into a Lobind tube for future BCA protein assay.

steps.title: Metabolite Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract metabolites using methanol containing internal standards.

substeps.instruction: Add 350 µL of MeOH containing internal standards at 37.5 ng/mL to the remaining 150 µL extraction solvent. MeOH used: LC-MS Chromasolv Fisher Scientific Catalog #15614740.

Internal standards include: Dimetridazole (Merck MilliporeSigma #31707, CAS: 551-92-8), 2-amino-3-(3-hydroxy-5-methyl-isoxazol-4-yl)propanoic acid (AMPA) (Merck MilliporeSigma #A0326, CAS: 83643-88-3), 2-methyl-4-chlorophenoxyacetic acid (MCPA) (Merck MilliporeSigma #45555, CAS: 94-74-6), and Dinoseb (Merck MilliporeSigma #45453, CAS: 88-85-7).
Vortex for 5 s.
Incubate on ice for 90 min to complete protein precipitation.

steps.title: Supernatant Fractionation
steps.instruction: Separate the supernatant into aliquots for different analyses.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 150 µL of supernatant for Hilicneg analysis.
Transfer 150 µL of supernatant for C18pos analysis.
Collect the remaining volume (approximately 150 µL) for the QCpool and aliquot 150 µL of QCpool.

steps.title: Drying and Storage
steps.instruction: Remove solvent from supernatants and store.

substeps.instruction: Dry supernatants under a nitrogen stream at 30 °C using a TurboVap LV evaporator (BIOTAGE).
Store dried extracts at -20 °C until analysis.

steps.title: BCA Protein Assay
steps.instruction: Perform a protein assay to determine the reconstitution volume for each sample.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 20 µL of each blank, standard, and sample into a well plate.
Add 200 µL of colored reagent.
Incubate the plate at 100 rpm, 40 °C, for 20 min.
Read the plate at 562 nm (range 540-590 nm).
Subtract average blank absorbance from other replicates; use quadratic curve fitting for validation (CV conc > std G).

steps.title: Mobile Phase Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the mobile phases for Hilic and C18 analyses.

substeps.instruction: Hilic Mobile Phase A: Add 0.9606 mg ammonium carbonate (Merck MilliporeSigma #379999, CAS: 506-87-6) to 1L water (Fisher #15665350), adjust pH to 10.5 with 25% ammonia solution (Merck MilliporeSigma #5438300100).
Hilic Mobile Phase B: 100% acetonitrile (ULC-MS Biosolve #0001204101BS).
C18 Mobile Phase A: Add 1 mL formic acid (Fisher #10780320, CAS: 64-18-6) to 1L water.
C18 Mobile Phase B: Add 1 mL formic acid to 1L acetonitrile.

steps.title: Hilic Analysis Reconstitution
steps.instruction: Reconstitute dried extracts for Hilic analysis in two steps based on protein content.

substeps.instruction: Determine volume based on a ratio of 1 mg protein / 50 µL (adapt if final volume is < 75 µL or > 300 µL). For QC, use the average of all sample volumes.
Step 1: Add 40% of the final volume of mobile phase A containing 2.5x external standards (ES*). Vortex 5 s.
Step 2: Add 60% of the final volume of mobile phase B. Vortex 5 s.
Transfer supernatant into 0.2 mL vials.

steps.title: C18 Analysis Reconstitution
steps.instruction: Reconstitute dried extracts for C18 analysis in one step based on protein content.

substeps.instruction: Determine volume based on a ratio of 1 mg protein / 50 µL (adapt if final volume is < 75 µL or > 300 µL).
Reconstitute in one step (implied by 'reconstitution in 1 step' and the provided reagents).
Transfer supernatant into 0.2 mL vials.

steps.title: QC Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare diluted QC samples for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 2-fold, 4-fold, and 8-fold diluted QC samples using mobile phases.
Add a mixture of mobile phase A / mobile phase B / ES* in a 90/5/5 ratio.
Vortex for 5 s.
Transfer supernatant into 0.2 mL vials.
